review_decision: Preserve required HELLO contracts and safe Rust decompositions. Fresh source-bound C/Rust evidence is required.

accepted_safe_decompositions.adjudication: Accepted safe Rust operation decomposition required. C heap/list/envelope/strings become caller-owned storage and immutable borrowed iterators; peer is an explicit copied public value. No C ABI, malloc/free or reentrant pointer mutation equivalence is claimed.

C verified operations map to parse+verify_at(profile,UTC), never to bare Rust parse. DHT C noverify YES internally validates, and its equivalent Rust case still verifies. VerifiedHello is not forgeable through public fields and does not itself authorize network dialing.

Rust representation preserves zero and accepts explicit UTC. C zero/default convenience is reproduced through default_expiration(now); real generated C bytes for all four serializers are compared. Formatting does not re-sign expired or changed metadata.

Rust finite exact slices, typed errors, transactional output refusal and caller ceilings are deliberate. C truncated-percent UAF, decimal conversion undefined behavior, invalid pointers, oversized narrowing and hidden literal NUL are not compatibility obligations. Safe negative tests cover corresponding Rust refusal; undefined C inputs were not executed.

dht_msg_to_block documents expired NO+block and invalid NULL output, while current code rejects expiry through nested parser and may leave freed out pointers. Rust matches usable success/failure semantics and avoids exposing dangling output parameters. Actual expired/wrong-peer/signature failures are observed.

The separately documented low-level wire UnverifiedHello decoder enforces advertised metadata and retains order; the official HELLO API correspondence uses gnunet_hello::Hello, which canonicalizes and ignores count/reserved as C. encode_signed_payload is the low-level helper used by this foundation. This distinction does not remove any required official operation.

Both normal and actual HELLO_DETERMINISTIC_PID_DERIVATION=1 libraries/configurations/macros are independently bound and exercised. The conditional HELLO hash/representation branch is covered. PILS deterministic identity derivation, communicators, service state and peer routing belong to other owners and are not prerequisites for this synchronous HELLO foundation claim.
